description: Interactive keyword index: one filter box, an A–Z jump strip, a term count per letter and an optional display limit over a hand-authored (or src JSON) index

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the filter input

attributes.name: letters
attributes.description: Jump strip: letters that have entries, the full A–Z plus any other letters present (É, Å…), or none

attributes.name: filter
attributes.description: What the filter box matches: terms and the titles of the pages they point to, or terms only

attributes.name: limit
attributes.description: Max entries per letter before a "Show N more" toggle

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of index JSON ([{ term, refs: [{ href, label, type? }] }]) that replaces the authored nav. Strings render as text; only http(s), relative and fragment hrefs become links.

attributes.name: data-label-controls
attributes.description: Accessible name of the controls search landmark

attributes.name: data-label-jump
attributes.description: Accessible name of the letter strip

attributes.name: data-label-terms
attributes.description: Term count beside each letter heading and as the hover hint on its jump letter ({count} is replaced)

attributes.name: data-label-terms-one
attributes.description: Term count for a letter with one term

attributes.name: data-label-matches-one
attributes.description: Live filter count for one match

attributes.name: data-label-no-matches
attributes.description: Live status when the filter matches nothing

structure.description: The index: a direct-child <nav> of <section id="index-x"> letter groups (or any <nav data-index>). Any aria-label works.
One letter group — <h2> plus <ul> of terms. The letter comes from the id, so index-é gives É.

childAttributes.name: data-index
childAttributes.description: Explicitly marks the index nav (otherwise the direct-child nav holding sections is used)
